name: The console reads plainly
prose: what the console shows can be told apart and read in full: reasoning stays collapsed by default and apart from the tool rows and answers around it; a provider retry is announced on the now-line of its own console or pane, and clears there; one long unbroken line never gives the transcript a sideways scroll bar; and the model picker names a model by its own name, with the full id on hover, never as "Custom…" over a truncated path, and offers only the focused tab's model.
invariant: The console keeps reasoning collapsed and apart from progress, shows retries, never scrolls sideways, and names the model by its own name.
